            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, CW, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(CW, CW, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),

        self.pi_direct = nn.Linear(nf, na)
        self.pi_h = nn.Linear(HID, na)
        self.v = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

        z = torch.cat([f, mask.to(obs.dtype)], dim=1)

        logits = self.pi_direct(z) + self.pi_h(h)

W = 32
P = 16
H = 16
DS = 16
DONE_BIAS = 2.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.nt = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = 12 + 3 + 1 + spec.n_types
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(cin, W, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.mixz = nn.Conv2d(2 * W, W, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.dconv = nn.Conv2d(2 * spec.Z, DS, 1)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64 + 2 * DS, 1)
        self.done_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1,), DONE_BIAS))
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64 + 2 * DS, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Z = self.Z
        Y = self.Y
        X = self.X
        L = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        zero = torch.zeros_like(L[:, :1])
        below = torch.cat([zero, L[:, :-1]], dim=1)
        above = torch.cat([L[:, 1:], zero], dim=1)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zpos = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / max(Z - 1, 1)).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, 1, self.nt, Y, X).expand(B, Z, self.nt, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([L, below, above, gl, zpos, m], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        f = F.relu(self.inp(x))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c1(f))
        f5 = f.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        ctx = f5.amax(1, keepdim=True).expand(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        f = F.relu(f + self.mixz(torch.cat([f5, ctx], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 2 * W, Y, X)))
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h).reshape(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            score = o[:, :, 0]
            gate = torch.softmax(o[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append((score * gate).sum(1).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        f5 = f.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f5.mean((1, 3, 4)), f5.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        d = F.relu(self.dconv(obs[:, 2 * Z:4 * Z]))
        gd = torch.cat([g, d.amax((2, 3)), d.mean((2, 3))], dim=1)
        done = self.done_head(gd) + self.done_bias
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gd).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.8, "ent_coef": 0.003, "ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.nt = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + spec.n_types, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no results yet. The starting architecture scored 0 on one seed. In a past world, 12 trials covering network families and moderate recipes all scored 0 in both training and dev. That points to a problem in the learning signal, the budget, or the interface rather than in generalisation. This round makes six candidates that are as different as possible and each tests one hypothesis. (1, 2) The stated action order or layout is wrong: flat or learned-readout heads that can learn any mapping, with the mask as an input. (3) The agent is short of samples: 1 epoch, small batches, about 200 updates. (4) The DONE decision and initialisation: a uniform starting policy, mask input, and a DONE logit driven by a summary of missing and extra cells. (5) The footprint-pool and anchor assumption: a deeper dilated ResNet with plain per-type conv heads. (6) Heavy sample reuse: 8 epochs, small batches, a longer horizon. Any non-zero training success will decide what round 2 builds on.
analyses.2: All six round-1 trials scored 0 in training and on dev. They covered a flat MLP, a flat conv readout, 1 versus 8 epochs, a mask input with zero init, a dilated per-type head, and gamma 0.99. Neither the network family nor moderate recipe changes made a difference, just as in the past world. Not even greedy dev success appeared. That suggests a structural blocker rather than weak placement. The leading suspect is DONE. An exact build only counts if the agent picks DONE right after the build is complete. At initialisation DONE has about 1/257 probability, so the agent almost never sees a reward for DONE when the build is complete. Without that experience it cannot learn when to stop, and even perfect placement then overshoots. Round 1 ruled out sample starvation from epoch count and an action-order mismatch (as far as the flat heads could test it). This round: two DONE-bias variants on different networks, a long-horizon recipe with no entropy, a separate value trunk, a layer-shared landing-gate network, and large batches with high entropy.
analyses.3:
All 12 trials have 0 training and 0 dev success. The trials covered conv, flat and per-layer networks, recipes from 1 to 8 epochs, lr from 5e-4 to 3e-3, gamma from 0.95 to 0.995, entropy 0 and 0.05, a separate value trunk, a positive DONE bias, and mask inputs. Network family, moderate recipe changes and a DONE bias of +3 did not matter. Some causes have not been tested yet:
(1) The policy may collapse to an early DONE. Random placements mostly add extra cells, which are penalised, so stopping looks safe. A negative starting DONE bias has never been tried, and the +3 bias pushed the wrong way.
(2) The action indices may be transposed or flipped relative to the observation. Conv heads cannot undo that, and flat heads lack the samples to learn around it.
(3) Few gradient steps: every trial used at most about 4,000 optimizer steps.
(4) Not enough per-column capacity to work out landing layers.
(5) Policy updates may be too large and destroy what was learned (lr 2e-4 and clip 0.1 are untested).
Each candidate tests one of these causes, with two variants of the DONE bias.
analyses.4: All 18 trials scored 0 in training and on dev. They spanned flat, conv, dilated, layer-shared and dihedral-layout networks. Recipes covered 1 to 8 epochs, lr 2e-4 to 3e-3, gamma 0.95 to 0.995, entropy 0 to 0.05, clip 0.1 to 0.3, 64 to 1024 envs, a separate value trunk, and DONE biases from -5 to +3. Neither network family nor recipe extremes made any difference. So the blocker is probably not ordinary optimisation. It may be an interface or world quirk that none of the trials tested. These are ruled out: transposed or flipped layouts with type-major order, anchor offsets up to 2, DONE timing, entropy collapse, too few optimiser steps, and a shared trunk. Still untested: cell-major action order, DONE as the first index, unexpected input scaling (normalisation), very many tiny updates, a myopic gamma of 0.9 with lambda 0.8, and a wide network. This is the last round, so each of the 6 candidates tests a different remaining hypothesis. Any score above 0 would show which one matters.
